record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare the ability ASSURANCE: Scraggy (1 star) and Scrafty (2 stars); both have maxPP 80, range 1 and declare the passive MOXIE. The strategy is shared; the only unit difference is the star count (table index). The name ASSURANCE is also an EffectEnum (Dark synergy: crit buff); this record covers only Ability.ASSURANCE.

dispatch.note: Routing: Ability.ASSURANCE (this strategy) is distinct from EffectEnum.ASSURANCE (Dark synergy effect in simulation.ts, crit stats). The strategy file never references the effect enum, so the synergy buff is not part of this ability's behaviour, although a Dark unit may hold both.

record.summary: Single-target SPECIAL damage on the cast target: raw 25/50/100/200 by caster stars, doubled when the caster's current HP is below 50% of its max HP at cast time (so 50 for Scraggy and 100 for Scrafty when low). AP scales it, crit applies only with ability crit. No status or movement.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read.

effects.scaling: requested = table value, or twice that when the caster is below 50% HP at cast time (strict <). AP: x(1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower (reduced by the target's critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false).
effects.resolution: Requested amount is the (possibly doubled) raw value; applied damage is intermediate: handleDamage divides by (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF), ceil, minimum 1, among other steps. Blocked completely (no damage) if the target is protected, skydiving or has magicBounce. The takenDamage return value is not read by this strategy.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 100 and 200 (fallback) entries are not reachable by the two units' bare star counts (1, 2). maxPP 80 and range 1 for both.

record.positionalConditions: None beyond needing a target (the unit must be in range of it to cast, since requiresTarget is true). The only condition is the caster's HP fraction, not any board position.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. The HP check is made fresh at every cast.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: 25/50 (SCRAGGY/SCRAFTY), 50/100 below 50% HP. Requested = raw (doubled or not); applied = requested x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor], then SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1) in handleDamage. Shield handling and takenDamage are in handleDamage and are not read by this strategy.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers); only the SPECIAL speDef division, minimum of 1 and the protect / skydiving / magicBounce block were read here
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution: only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier were read
